research_rationale: EO 13037 (1997-03-03), 62 FR 10185, FR machine text, original text step done. One Commission (secs. 1-5). Sec. 5 as issued is event-relative (30 days after the report); EO 13108 (1998-12-11, 63 FR 69175) replaced it with a stated date: the Commission terminates "on September 30, 1999". EO 13066 (1997-10-29) touched only the membership cap and the sec. 3 report wording. EO 13138 sec. 3(d), effective 1999-09-30 (sec. 9), revokes EO 13037 as amended as an order that established a committee that has terminated and whose work is completed; same date, not earlier. Earlier-end check: dossier chain, ACT rows and EDGES for EO 13066, 13108, 13138 read directly; sweep of held texts for the number 13037 found no other instrument. Later-change check: no held extension of 1999-09-30. Weak points: the end sits in an amending order, not in a TERM record of EO 13037; the OCR and Federal Register machine text is not page-checked; FACA's statutory two-year charter default is not an own term and is not held. AI hypothesis, not a certification. See OTE:EO:13037@lamm in OWN_TERM_END_RECORDS.jsonl.

savings.reason: Read EO 13037, EO 13066, EO 13108 and EO 13138 in full. None has a savings, exceptions or continuing-effect clause; EO 13138 sec. 3(d) revokes EO 13037 as amended by EO 13066 and 13108 (effective 1999-09-30) without reserving anything, and nothing is saved or transferred when the Commission ends.
